questions.text: What problem did people face when swapping goods without money?
options: They could not agree on the value of things
questions.explanation: The lesson says swapping is confusing because nobody can agree on the value of things.

questions.text: Why did people like using smaller coins instead of many gold coins?
options: Because gold is heavy and valuable
questions.explanation: The lesson says carrying many gold coins would make your backpack super heavy, so people liked smaller coins.

questions.text: What happens when you tap a payment card at a shop?
options: The card sends a secret message to the bank
The card tells the shop to give change
questions.explanation: The lesson says inside every card is a secret message; when you tap, it sends a quick message to a bank.

questions.text: Money used to be gold, then paper, and now it is invisible numbers on screens.
questions.explanation: The lesson states money used to be gold, then paper, and now it is invisible numbers on screens.
